trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==7]
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    a=min(r for r,c in pts); b=max(r for r,c in pts)
    l=min(c for r,c in pts); h=max(c for r,c in pts)
    return [[7 if v==7 else 0 for v in row[l:h+1]] for row in grid[a:b+1]]

result.message: Program received. The trial is complete.
